name: Podium Trophies
author: Sedz
description: A podium trophy for every track. Pair trophies with the tracks in your profile on the Trophies page, base game or modded; a track addon can carry its own trophy, which it gets automatically. Ships Bahrain (career cabinet trophy) and Austria.

options.label: Build every trophy (test)
options.description: Adds every installed trophy to the podium scene, also the ones no track is paired with. For testing how many trophy types the game takes; leave it off otherwise.
